lines.label: Change
lines.note: Innate: Briar's basic attacks and abilities inflict a bleed against enemies for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications, stacking up to 9 times and dealing 25% damage for stacks beyond the first. The bleed dealsBriar heal herself equal to 25% of the dealt. If a target dies while bleeding, she will heal herself equal to 100% of the remaining bleed damage.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Briar has no health regeneration|base health regeneration, but she increases healing from all sources by 0–50% (over 0–100)|health.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active: Briar dash to the target unit. If the target is an enemy, she deals 60–220 (+ 80% bonus AD) physical damage, stun them for 0.85 seconds, and inflicts them with 10–26%|armor armor penetration|armor reduction for 5 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Cost: 6% current health.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Cooldown: 13–9 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Cast Time: None, Target Range: cr 450.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active: Briar dash to the target location. If there is a nearby enemy upon her arrival, she gains Blood Frenzy for 5 seconds, during which she can cast Snack Attack}}.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Blood Frenzy: Briar breaks free from her pillory, turning berserk against the nearest enemy. She standard sight the target and gains ghosting, 60–120% bonus attack speed and 24–60% bonus movement speed, as well as empowering her basic attacks to deal 60–100% AD physical damage to enemies surrounding her target. This damage is affected by critical strike modifiers.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Briar prioritizes attacking champions, then large monsters, and then minions.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Blood Frenzy ends early if there are no longer any nearby valid targets or Chilling Scream}} is cast. If Head Rush}} is cast on a non-champion, Briar will stop prioritizing champions during the frenzy. Blood Frenzy basic attack reset Briar's basic attack timer. Head Rush}} and Certain Death}} can be cast during the dash.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Cost: 6% current health.

lines.note: Cooldown: 14–10 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Snack Attack deals 120% damage against minions and monsters, with the damage based on the target's health ratio being capped at 500.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Snack Attack basic attack reset Briar's basic attack timer.

lines.label: Change

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active: Briar channel for up to 1 second, during which she increases Chilling Scream's damage and range, and gains 35% damage reduction and heal herself for 10/4 to 16/4% maximum health every 0.25 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Chilling Scream can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards. Chilling Scream's charge cannot be interrupt by crowd control.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Recast: Briar unleashes a scream in the target direction that deals 80–220 (+ 100% bonus AD) (+ 100% AP) magic damage to enemies hit and slow them by 80% for 0.5 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: If Chilling Scream was charged for its full duration, enemies hit are also airborne 575 units. If they collide with terrain, they will rebound to take 140–440 (+ 240% bonus AD) (+ 240% AP) and become airborne for 0.5 seconds and stun for 1.5 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Cost: 6% current health.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active: Briar kicks a hemolith in the target direction that briefly grants sight of its as it and marks the first enemy champion hit as her prey, disrupt their ongoing channel and true sight them.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: If a target is hit, Briar cleanse herself from all crowd control and destroys her pillory over a cast time, afterwards dash to them with displacement immunity. Upon arrival, she creates an explosion around the marked target that deals 150–500 (3 ranks) (+ 110% bonus AD) (+ 110% AP) physical damage to them and nearby enemies and flee all non-marked targets for 1.5 seconds. She then enters a state of Hematomania.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Hematomania: Briar gains all effects of Blood Frenzy}} against the marked target as well as bonus armor and bonus magic resistance equal to 20% AD, 10–20 (3 ranks)% life steal|life steal, and 10–30 (3 ranks)% ms|additional bonus movement speed|ms.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Hematomania lasts until the marked target dies. If the target becomes invalid, Briar will turn berserk against the nearest until her target becomes valid again.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Casting Chilling Scream}} ends Hematomania early.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Summoned terrain now counts as a knockback and applies airborne to enemies knocked by being within the perimeter interval.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: In particular, this means displacement immune dashes now properly resist the push, and are thereby no longer overridden by it.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: This makes it consistent with similar spells such as Crystallize (Anivia)}} and Dark Procession (Yorick)}}.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: The knockback is sourced from the wall segment that applied it, not Jarvan IV, meaning it does not trigger effects such as Aftershock}} or Glacial Augment}} for him.
